  - add_business_days(date(2026, 3, 6), 5) -> date(2026, 3, 13) (Fri -> following Fri, skipping weekends)
  - add_business_days(date(2026, 3, 7), 0) -> date(2026, 3, 9) (start on weekend rolls forward)
  - add_business_days(date(2026, 3, 7), 0, holidays=[date(2026, 3, 9)]) -> depends on holiday handling of the forward roll
  - add_business_days(date(2026, 3, 6), -1) -> previous business day (accounting for weekends/holidays)

- business_days_between
  - business_days_between(date1, date2, holidays=[...]) returns the count of business days in [date1, date2)
  - business_days_between(date2, date1, holidays=[...]) returns the negative count

  - due_date(date(2026, 3, 7), "due_on_receipt") -> date(2026, 3, 9)
